entry.title: New: Bill 186 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10, DIVISION 5, SECTION 24-280, SCHEDULE 28 OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO NO PARKING AT ANYTIME

Prohibits parking alongside two portions of Kalapana-Kapoho Beach Road from (1) a point 320 feet southwest of Pohoiki Road and extending 165 feet in the southwesterly direction

Latest action: Council: Bill 186 passes second & final reading - 9/4/2024
